baseline.scope: Selected revision Markdown/editor/titlebar/highlight hook and desktop; all other current source/config/dependencies and core are shared. Temporary comparison host, not an installer.

shared: Same current core/dependencies/config/search styles and fixture. Frozen selected sources and desktop from the recorded revision; only Markdown differs among those four restored UI sources.
method: Three fresh alternating Linux Electron pairs per workload, no concurrent tests/benchmarks. Every streamed update observed committed. Five post-diagnostic-renderer-GC samples per phase; medians within process then across three processes. Order reversed for middle pair; not randomized inference.
